tasks.title: Initialize repository and project folder structure
tasks.description: Create the root Git repository, configure .gitignore, and initialize separate frontend and backend directories with package.json files.
userStories: As a developer, I want an organized project repository so that I can manage frontend and backend code cleanly.
acceptanceCriteria: Git repository is initialized with a valid .gitignore excluding node_modules and database files.
Both /client and /server folders exist with initialized package.json files.

tasks.title: Set up Express server and SQLite database
tasks.description: Install Express, CORS, and SQLite packages in the backend, configure the server entry point, and create the todos table schema on startup.
userStories: As a developer, I want a working server connected to SQLite so that task data can be stored persistently.
acceptanceCriteria: Express server starts without errors on the configured port.
SQLite database file is created automatically with a todos table containing id, title, completed, and created_at columns.

tasks.title: Implement CRUD REST API endpoints for todos
tasks.description: Create GET /api/todos, POST /api/todos, PATCH /api/todos/:id, and DELETE /api/todos/:id endpoints with basic input validation and HTTP status codes.
userStories: As a user, I want the backend to support creating, reading, updating, and deleting tasks so that my changes are saved.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/todos returns a JSON array of all saved tasks with HTTP 200.
POST /api/todos validates a non-empty title, inserts the task, and returns HTTP 201.
PATCH /api/todos/:id updates the completed status and returns HTTP 200.
DELETE /api/todos/:id removes the task and returns HTTP 200 or 204.

tasks.title: Initialize React frontend and API service
tasks.description: Set up the React application in the client folder and create an API helper module using fetch or axios to communicate with the Express endpoints.
userStories: As a developer, I want a React setup with a dedicated API module so that UI components can interact cleanly with the backend.
acceptanceCriteria: React development server starts cleanly and renders the root component.
API service exports functions for getTodos, createTodo, toggleTodo, and deleteTodo.

tasks.title: Build task list view and add-task form
tasks.description: Create the main Todo components to fetch and display existing tasks on load and allow submitting a new task via an input form.
userStories: As a user, I want to add a new task and see my list of tasks so that I can keep track of what I need to do.
acceptanceCriteria: Existing tasks from the database render on page load.
Submitting the form with a valid title creates a task in the database and displays it immediately.
Empty form submissions are prevented.

tasks.title: Implement task completion toggle and delete actions
tasks.description: Add a checkbox to each task item to toggle its completed status and a delete button to remove the task from the list and database.
userStories: As a user, I want to check off completed tasks and delete unwanted ones so that my list stays up to date.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking a task checkbox updates its completed state in the UI and persists across page reloads.
Clicking the delete button removes the task from the UI and deletes it from SQLite.

tasks.title: Add status filters and clean responsive styling
tasks.description: Implement All, Active, and Completed filter buttons above the task list and apply clean CSS styling for desktop and mobile viewports.
userStories: As a user, I want to filter tasks by status so that I can focus on remaining tasks.
acceptanceCriteria: Selecting All, Active, or Completed displays only the matching tasks.
Completed tasks display a visual strikethrough style.
Layout remains readable on both mobile and desktop screen sizes.

tasks.title: Write basic API and component tests
tasks.description: Add automated tests covering the main REST API CRUD routes and basic React rendering of the task list.
userStories: As a developer, I want automated tests for core features so that I can verify everything works reliably.
acceptanceCriteria: API tests verify creating, listing, toggling, and deleting a todo.
All configured tests run and pass via npm test.

tasks.title: Perform end-to-end QA, production build, and documentation
tasks.description: Test the complete application flow manually, verify the frontend production build, and write a README with installation and startup instructions.
userStories: As a user or developer, I want clear documentation and a verified build so that I can run the application easily.
acceptanceCriteria: Frontend builds cleanly with no build errors.
All user flows pass manual verification against the running backend.
README.md documents prerequisites, setup steps, and available scripts.
